page_title: Future proof your business with GTM AI

summary.name: Copy.ai
summary.one_liner: Copy.ai is a go-to-market (GTM) AI platform that combines sales prospecting, content creation, lead processing, ABM, localization and deal forecasting into one system instead of separate AI copilots.
use_cases: generating SEO and thought leadership content
enriching and engaging inbound marketing leads
scoring deals and predicting close dates
summary.what_it_does: The page presents Copy.ai as a single AI-native GTM platform covering use cases such as prospecting, content creation, inbound lead processing, account based marketing, translation and localization, and deal coaching and forecasting. Its stated building blocks are Workflows (codified processes and plays), Actions, Agents (AI decision-making with guardrails), Tables (a queryable data foundation), Chat for one-off tasks, Infobase (a company knowledge repository), and Brand Voice for consistent content. The page claims 2,000+ integrations and that the platform is LLM model agnostic. Access is via a demo request; no pricing is shown.
notable: Single GTM platform with Workflows, Agents, Tables, Chat, Infobase and Brand Voice components
